messages.subject: New paper using Stan
parts:
Here is our first paper on sentence comprehension processes that uses Stan (attached). I'm curious to see how much trouble we will get into for not using frequentist methods. I'm not sure whether we violated the journal policy on data analysis (http://ees.elsevier.com/cognit/img/Editorial_Policy.pdf) but I think we didn't do anything that goes against it.

@unpublished{HusainEtAl2014,
  title={Strong expectations cancel locality effects: Evidence from Hindi},
  author={Husain, Samar and Vasishth, Shravan and Narayanan, Srinivasan},
  year={2014},
  note={Submitted to Cognition}
}
